description: An agent-native web security workspace. Find vulnerabilities through red-teaming. Formally verify properties of Rust codes in Lean 4.

written.description: Gives an agent a browser that controls its own network traffic, so the model can capture, edit, replay and compare the requests a web app sends without a proxy in between. Each session runs under a network policy and records every fetch it allowed or refused.

alive.last_commit_message:
Improve lean UI (#704)

* docs: propose guarantee-centered app console design

* feat: add app guarantee review and verification evidence to console

* feat: derive Lean dependency diagrams from check catalogs

* fix: initialize app report inputs without clippy warnings

* update

* add topbar to projects page

* add favicon to console

* make theorem panel resizable and highlight rust and lean

* link findings to history and hold live rows

* document expect verdicts and the Nuclei importer

* add guarantee maps to app tutorials

* improve app console focus, flow layout and drift warning

* find the console script by kind, not by order

* add full screen for the guarantee map

* sort projects by date or open findings
